messages:
Maya (infra): alert: spike in 5xx for hosted-api eu-west-1, started at ~2043219800. svc-auth failing to decrypt session tokens
IncidentBot: Paging: eng-oncall @rohit — Severity P2 — Multiple customers affected in eu-west-1, degraded throughput
Rohit (eng-oncall): on it. Maya, any recent deploys or config pushes?
Maya (infra): yes — deploy 2024.11.6 rolled at 2043217200 updated env KMS_KEY_ARN and flipped feature flag `new-auth-flow` to `true` for 10% canary.
Liam (sre): seeing logs: `decrypt: access denied for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/xxxx` and also `Key not found: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/yyyy` — looks like mixed key ids across replicas
Rohit (eng-oncall): hypothesis: feature flag enabled new code path that tries to use rotated KMS key id from ENV, but some hosts still have old env or missing IAM perms. Need quick mitigation.
Jen (ops): can we toggle flag off from feature-flag console? That should short-circuit to legacy decrypt logic.
Sam (product): if we toggle off, risk: canary won't continue but customers are impacted. Prefer kill-switch then roll back config.
Rohit (eng-oncall): agreed. Taking kill-switch and rollback plan: 1) flip `new-auth-flow` -> false 2) revert env KMS_KEY_ARN to previous value 3) rollback deployment if needed 4) verify in canary then scale back.
Rohit (eng-oncall): @Maya can you run flag toggle?
Maya (infra): running: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' https://flags.internal/api/v1/flags/new-auth-flow -d '{"enabled":false}'```
Maya (infra): toggled off. Monitoring metrics... 503s dropping slightly
Paula (support): heads up — customers A & B reported failures. I'm preparing customer notifications and credit draft.
Liam (sre): rolling back env on pods now: `kubectl set env deployment/auth-service KMS_KEY_ARN=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/old-key -n hosted` then rolling restart
Maya (infra): applied env revert to canary pods, waiting for pod ready.
Rohit (eng-oncall): if env revert fixes decrypts, do full rollout of env revert across region. If not, full rollback to v2024.11.5.
Maya (infra): canary looks green — decrypt errors for canary down to baseline in last 30s.
Rohit (eng-oncall): proceeding: propagate env revert to all replicas now. ETA ~3m
IncidentBot: Incident update: mitigation in progress — new-auth-flow toggled off, env KMS_KEY_ARN reverted in eu-west-1, customer impact reduced. Severity remains P2 until stabilized.
Paula (support): sending proactive notes to top impacted customers, CC'ing account teams. Draft: "we observed authentication errors caused by a keys/config mismatch after a deploy. We have reverted the configuration and disabled new-auth-flow. Services should be functioning. We're issuing credits; follow-up postmortem will be shared."
Sam (product): add follow-up action: halt next canary until postmortem and add automated preflight for env/key consistency.
Liam (sre): making an emergency runbook item: verify KMS key ARN presence and decrypt test during deploy. I'll open a quick PR to CI checks.
Rohit (eng-oncall): switching pager to monitoring; will hand off to oncall tomorrow. Summary for postmortem: cause = race between KMS key rotation + feature flag enabling new decrypt path; root cause = config propagation gap + missing cross-account IAM binding on some instances; mitigation = kill-switch, env revert, rollback avoided. Actions: preflight CI check, feature-flag gating tied to config rollout, add canary-decrypt healthcheck.
Maya (infra): logs stabilizing. 1xx -> 2xx success for most requests in eu-west-1.
Paula (support): customers notified. No escalation to sales yet.
Rohit (eng-oncall): thanks team. I'll file incident ticket and schedule postmortem with runbook authoring. If anything regresses, re-pager.
Maya (infra): saving screenshots and logs to incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2043
IncidentBot: Incident closed to response phase — monitoring only.
Paula (support): recording follow-up actions for comms: postmortem, customer credits, timeline.
Sam (product): note: block next deploy of new-auth-flow until CI & infra sign-off.
Rohit (eng-oncall): handoff: oncall shift ends in 2h, I'll ensure SLO/metrics alerts are on. Closing thread here.
